# Guide

The guide explains how **Sample** runs a `workflow` end to end,
and why each step records its evidence.

## Setup

- Install the CLI with npm.
- Run `sample init` in your repository.
  The command writes a starter config.
- Commit the config.

1. First numbered step.
2. Second numbered step.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--fast` | Skip the slow checks. |
| `--dry-run` | Print what would change. |

```sh
sample run --fast
sample report
```

> A gate holds until the evidence arrives.
> It never times out on its own.
